'''2020 TMW Pods Rikard Eriksen LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rikard Eriksen]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Rikard Eriksen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TIGIH Eriksen LS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
